text:
Ava: quick eyes on PR #9120? Buildkite is failing on an intermittent integration test so it's blocking the autoscaler fix merge. https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/9120

deploy-bot: Buildkite — #9120/integration-prefix-cache (agent-23) — failed — view: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/9120/builds/58

Ravi: on it. which test is failing?

Ava: tests/integration/prefix_cache_eviction_test.py — seems to time out trying to wait for eviction to complete, only on linux-gpu runners. Happened twice in a row.

Ivy: saw this morning too. stack trace points to kv-sync background worker getting stuck in the eviction loop. could be a race introduced by the prefetch change.

Sam: i'll kick a rebuild now. if it passes we can probably merge; if it flakes again we should either xfail the test or revert the change.

Sam: @deploy-bot rerun build 58 for #9120

deploy-bot: Buildkite — retriggered by Sam — #9120 build queued (agent pool: linux-gpu)

Sam: running. i can also run the integration locally with --stress and increased logging.

Ravi: thanks. i'll try a local repro with the prefetch optimization disabled to see if failure stops. if rerun is green and nothing looks off i'll approve.

Ava: appreciate it. this PR contains an autoscaler fix so we want to get it merged today if possible.

Ivy: adding a short note to the PR about quick revert instructions in case we need to back it out fast.

Ravi: quick update — rerun is in progress, logs look similar so far but not failed yet. will post results shortly.

Ava: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

(If rerun fails again, i'm fine with temporarily xfixing the test and filing a follow-up to investigate the race.)
